subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Get ready for… (Pre A1 Starters) + Unit 2 sounds review
outcomes: I can listen and find the picture with the right school things.
I can follow Point to the … and say It's a …
I can write words like man, sack, sit, tick and tin.

tf.s: Point to the bag means show me the bag with your finger.
What's this? is a question about a thing.
He's got a pencil means he has no pencil.
tf.why: He's got a pencil means he has one.

tf.s: We answer What's this? with It's a crayon.
We answer What's this? with I'm six.
tf.why: We say It's a … for a thing.

tf.s: For cat, the missing letter in c – a – _ is t.
t – h – a in order makes hat.
tf.why: The order is h-a-t to make hat.

tf.s: Sack ends with the letter s.
Tick and tin start with the same sound.
Man starts with the letter n.

boxes.q: Point to the pencil case. You point to …
A has got a ruler. B hasn't got a ruler. What is different?
boxes.why: Only A has got the ruler.

boxes.q: Order the letters: t, h, a

hunt.q: Catch the letters at the end of sack.
Order the letters: c, p, a
Order the letters: t, i, h
Catch the school thing for colouring.

mcq.q: Which one is a school thing?
mcq.why: A pencil case is a school thing.

mcq.q: Which is the answer to What's this?

o: i, m, h, c, k, ck, r
mcq.why: Unit 2 letters: i, m, h, c, k, ck, r.

mcq.q: Which of these words ends with ck?
Listen: I've got a book and a pencil. Which picture do you tick?
mcq.why: Tick the book and the pencil.

mcq.q: You are the examiner. What can you say?
mcq.why: Point to the … is a good instruction.

mcq.q: Dictation: s – a – ck. You write …
Picture A: a pen and a book. Picture B: a pen. What has B not got?
mcq.why: B has only a pen, no book.

mcq.q: Which word does not belong: man, map, mat, hat?
mcq.why: Hat starts with /h/; the others start with /m/.

mcq.q: Tick and tin. What is different?
mcq.why: t-i-ck and t-i-n: only the last sound changes.
